business_objective: Verify and fulfill requests for duplicate policy documents and close each request after acknowledged handover.

stakeholder_statements.text: A policyholder submits a request for a duplicate policy document and identifies the policy.
The service clerk confirms that the policy is active and that the requester is the recorded policyholder.
The records officer retrieves the latest issued policy document and marks the duplicate ready for release.
The delivery clerk records the document handover, and the policyholder acknowledges receipt.
The operations lead closes the request only after receipt is acknowledged. Policy changes and claim handling are outside this project.

business_objective: Review and file construction progress photographs as evidence for identified work packages.

stakeholder_statements.text: A site photographer submits a progress photograph and records the work area and capture date.
The site supervisor records the work activity shown and the related work package.
The quality reviewer records the photograph as clear or requiring a retake and adds a reason when a retake is required.
The project records clerk files a clear photograph under the related work package.
The construction manager closes the photograph request only after the photograph is filed. Image editing and progress-payment certification are outside this project.

business_objective: Review member chapter-transfer requests and update membership records after current-chapter clearance and destination acceptance.

stakeholder_statements.text: A member submits a chapter transfer request and identifies the current chapter, destination chapter, and transfer reason.
The current chapter secretary confirms that the membership is active and records whether local obligations are cleared. The local-obligation list has not been agreed.
The destination chapter coordinator accepts or declines the request and may add a decision comment.
The membership records officer changes the member's chapter only after active membership, cleared local obligations, and destination acceptance are recorded.
The member services clerk sends the transfer outcome to the member, but the delivery channel is undecided. Membership-fee collection and chapter-event registration are outside this project.

business_objective: Coordinate vehicle-cleaning tasks and return vehicles to the assignment pool only after hygiene clearance.

stakeholder_statements.text: A driver reports a vehicle cleanliness issue and identifies the vehicle and affected area.
The fleet service coordinator creates a cleaning task and assigns a priority. The priority rule has not been agreed.
The cleaning technician records the cleaning actions and marks the task complete.
The hygiene inspector records the vehicle as cleared or requiring repeat cleaning. The clearance criteria are not finalized.
The fleet scheduler may return the vehicle to the assignment pool only when it is cleared. Cleaning-supplier payment and mechanical repair are outside this project.

business_objective: Record assessment results, moderate them, and publish final results while preserving an unresolved rule about provisional-result visibility.

stakeholder_statements.text: The instructor records an assessment result and feedback for each learner.
The course lead says provisional results may be shown to learners as soon as the instructor records them, even while moderation is pending.
The moderator records a moderation outcome, any required result changes, and moderation comments. The moderation criteria are not finalized.
The academic quality officer records the moderation outcome as accepted or returned. The officer says no result may be visible to learners until the moderation outcome is accepted.

The results coordinator records a publication decision after an accepted moderation outcome and any required changes are present, then publishes the final results. Nobody has decided who confirms that required changes are complete or how quickly publication must happen. The meeting also wandered into complaints about the classroom blinds.
